issues.desc: background.md Key Insights says "reuse the recovery-runner agentRun" as if agentRun is an importable export, but experiments/recovery-runner/run-recovery.mjs defines agentRun as a local (non-exported) function. An implementer following the background would find no exported agentRun to import; they must either duplicate the logic or refactor run-recovery.mjs to export it.

background.md Solution Tradeoffs refers to "the e8aca935 session" without explaining what type of identifier e8aca935 is (git commit SHA? Lattice session ID? something else). A new reader cannot verify or look up this reference.

background.md Trigger Event mentions "The paper's tab:recovery" — this is a LaTeX cross-reference label that a new reader (without access to the paper LaTeX source) cannot locate or verify without additional context.
